# Satnam

> Satnam is a sovereign Nostr identity registrar. It hands out NIP-05 names and
> Lightning addresses, binds them to physical NFC multi-factor tags, and can
> birth agent identities into the same role structure that human groups use.
> A Family Foundry flow founds human family and business identities; a
> Bot-Mother flow births agent identities. The two sides mirror each other:
> guardian, steward, adult, offspring apply to both.

## Who this is for

Agents and LLM crawlers that need to discover how Satnam works and what it
exposes. Satnam is deliberately open to machine discovery. We do not block
crawlers; we rate-limit and flag instead of building walls.

## The short version

- Registrar: https://satnam.pub
- Bridge (Lightning address / LNURL surface): https://bridge.satnam.pub
- Relays: wss://relay.satnam.pub (human lane), wss://relay.shock.network (agent lane)
- Public fallback relays, OTP-style direct messages only: wss://relay.damus.io, wss://relay.nostr.band
- NIP-05 directory: https://satnam.pub/.well-known/nostr.json
- Registrar handshake (one fetch, machine readable): https://satnam.pub/.well-known/satnam.json
- OpenAPI 3.1 description: https://satnam.pub/openapi.json

## Endpoints

### POST /bot-mother/birth
Births an agent identity. Requires NIP-98 authentication. Accepts a label and an
optional tier. Returns a public key, a secret reference (never the secret
itself), lineage fields, and a mirror receipt.

Current status: implemented and gated. The route is default-off and returns
501 `live_requires_authorization` until the operator enables it. Dry mode builds
the real enrolment request and sends nothing. Do not treat this endpoint as
live until the handshake file reports `status: active`.

### GET /api/nfc/scan
Verifies a physical NFC tag tap (SUN cryptographic verification with counter
monotonicity and replay rejection). Public by design, rate-limited per card.

Current status: implemented and gated behind the issuer flag, default-off.

### GET /health
Liveness for the daemon. Unauthenticated by design.

## Conventions

- Identity: NIP-05 names, NIP-19 nprofile with relay hints
- Signing: NIP-46 remote signer (the signer is the only component that touches a
  key; browsers and PWAs never hold one)
- Delegation: scoped authority rows with narrowed event kinds and expiry
- Authentication to Satnam endpoints: NIP-98 signed requests
- Lightning: CLINK-protocol offers and proof-of-work throttling
- Tags: NTAG424 DNA with SUN verification

## What Satnam does not do

- It does not hold user keys server-side.
- It does not publish a live birth path before the operator enables it.
- It does not promise autonomous agent behaviour, revenue, or outcomes.

## Contact

Operated by Livingry Services. Human contact and service detail: https://satnam.pub
